relations.subject: Ernst Curtius
relations.evidence: he was chosen by C. A. Brandis to accompany him on a journey to Greece for the prosecution of archaeological researches

relations.subject: Ernst Curtius
relations.evidence: Curtius then became Karl Otfried Müller's companion in his exploration of the Peloponnese, and on Müller's death in 1840 he returned to Germany.

relations.subject: Ernst Curtius
relations.evidence: In 1844, he became an extraordinary professor at the University of Berlin

relations.subject: Ernst Curtius
relations.evidence: After holding a professorship at Göttingen

relations.subject: Ernst Curtius
relations.evidence: Curtius was appointed (in 1863) ordinary professor at Berlin.

relations.subject: Ernst Curtius
relations.evidence: Following the death of Eduard Gerhard in 1867, Curtius succeeded him as professor of classical archaeology at Berlin.

relations.subject: Ernst Curtius
relations.evidence: At the same time, Curtius served as a director of the Altes Museum and Antiquarium.
